title: Tomato Egg Scramble
steps: Beat the egg and finely chop the tomato.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add tomato and sauté for 2 minutes.
Pour in the egg mixture and scramble until cooked.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Ham & Egg Omelette
steps: Beat eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add eggs, cook until they start to set.
Sprinkle diced ham on one half, fold omelette.
